title.value: What if We Enrich day-ahead Solar Irradiance Time Series Forecasting with Spatio-Temporal Context?
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: What if We Enrich day-ahead Solar Irradiance Time Series Forecasting with Spatio-Temporal Context?

extractions.description: The paper presents a deep learning architecture that uses spatio-temporal context from satellite data for highly accurate day-ahead time-series forecasting of Global Horizontal Irradiance (GHI). It includes a multi-quantile variant for uncertainty estimation and a testing scheme to evaluate model performance under varying cloud conditions.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving solar power integration into the electrical grid, directly addressing climate change mitigation by reducing greenhouse gas emissions and reliance on fossil fuels.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: This research holds profound potential to positively influence society by promoting the effective integration of solar power into our electrical grid, a significant stride towards carbon neutrality and climate change mitigation. Accurate solar irradiance forecasts will enable more efficient grid management and reduced reliance on fossil-fuel reserves.

primary_category.justification: The primary focus is on improving the efficiency and reliability of solar power integration into the grid, which directly contributes to reducing reliance on fossil fuels and mitigating climate change.
primary_category.quote: Solar power is a vital renewable energy source with the potential to mitigate climate change effects by reducing greenhouse gas emissions

primary_sub_category.justification: The research aims to improve the forecasting of solar irradiance to optimize grid management and the integration of solar power.
primary_sub_category.quote: Accurate solar irradiance forecasting can help grid operators manage this variability, leading to more efficient and reliable grid integration of solar power, and reducing the need for costly, environmentally damaging backup power sources.
